channel.title: The BlackSheep Journal
channel.description: Notes on real estate, dealership and event media in Ontario from BlackSheep Digital Works.

item.title: Listing in winter: how to plan photos around Durham's short days
item.description: In Durham, the sun sets before 4:50 p.m. from mid-November through the solstice. Here is how to schedule a winter listing shoot around the light, and why the quieter December market makes good photos count.

item.title: Inventory photos for Ontario dealerships: what OMVIC's advertising guideline expects from your images
item.description: Vehicle photos and videos are advertising under Ontario's dealer rules. Here is what OMVIC's Advertising Guideline says about stock photos, the actual unit, sold vehicles and social posts, and how to build an inventory shoot around it.

item.title: Durham's October 2026 market, town by town: more choice for buyers, more reason to stand out
item.description: TRREB's October 2026 figures for Durham Region, broken down by municipality, and what a market with roughly three new listings for every sale means for how a home is presented.

item.title: Listing photos and RECO's advertising rules: consent, accuracy and the expiry date
item.description: Listing photos and video are advertising under Ontario's real estate rules. Here is what RECO's bulletins say about consent, accuracy and how long media can stay online.

item.title: Drone shots for your listing: what Canada's rules actually require
item.description: Aerial photos sell the lot, the street and the setting. Here is what Transport Canada requires before a drone goes up over your listing, and the questions to ask whoever flies it.
